The role is based in XJTLU Entrepreneur College (Taicang) and is expected to work closely with academic staff across the University, the Health and Safety Office, the Management Information Technology and System Office, the Campus Management Office, and industry partners. We sincerely welcome people who would be proactive, reflective, and committed to on-time delivery, with a high level of professional ethics to join us.
在芯片学院（CHIPS）学院技术经理和院长的监督下，这个岗位主要提供以下技术支持:1.多学科和跨学科的教学和研究活动提供技术支持; 2. 以研究为主导、以实践为驱动的教学模式; 3. 国内外合作研究项目。
